# Ludovico Ferro
## Ludovico Ferro
### Tenure
**Ludovico Ferro** is a designer who interned at Hot Wheels in 2005. The only car he designed was Blastous , a Torpedoes car that came out in the 2005 First Editions . In addition to his experience as an intern at Hot Wheels, Ferro also interned for Little Tikes and worked for competing brand Spin Master. He is currently an architect at FK Architects based in Florida.
